syllabus_topics: Magnetic induction phenomena (bodies at rest and in motion)
Elementary circuits in quasi-stationary regime (forced and transient regimes)
Variable electromagnetic field (electromagnetic waves; frequency domain)
assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) is calculated as 0.25 * NL + 0.75 * NT, where NL is the laboratory grade and NT is the mini-test grade. A minimum of 9.5 out of 20 is required for NL, and a minimum of 8.0 out of 20 for NT. Students can retake or improve mini-test grades during the exam period, with the best score counting. For the Special Exam period, the final grade is 0.25 * NL + 0.75 * NEE (Special Exam grade), with NL >= 9.5 and NEE >= 8.0.
bibliography: J. A. Brandão Faria, Electromagnetic Foundations of Electrical Engineering, Wiley & Sons (ISBN 978-0-470-72709-6), August 2008 (main)
V. Maló Machado, Coletânea de Problemas de Electrotecnia Teórica, Author edition, IST, Lisbon, february 2018 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LEEC21 Eng. Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (IST)
degree: Licenciatura Bolonha em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC21)
